description: This Java source file defines an immutable class {@link ImmutableFeatureDefinition} that implements the {@link FeatureDefinition} interface. It provides functionality to create, manipulate, and serialize feature definitions, including parsing from JSON and building instances via a fluent builder pattern.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatureDefinition
classes.description: An immutable implementation of {@link FeatureDefinition} that manages a list of feature identifiers. It supports JSON parsing, serialization, and providing a stream or iterator over its identifiers.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatureDefinition.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of {@link ImmutableFeatureDefinition} in a fluent manner. Supports adding, removing, and building with at least one identifier.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableFeatureDefinition instance by parsing a JsonArray containing feature identifier strings. Ignores non-string values and throws exceptions if array is null, empty, or contains invalid identifiers.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Provides a new builder initialized with a first identifier.

methods.name: getFirstIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the first feature identifier in the list.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the total number of feature identifiers contained.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a Stream of the feature identifiers.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the feature identifiers.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the feature identifiers into a JsonArray.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the list of feature identifiers.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the list of feature identifiers.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object with class name and identifier list.
